key.title: Key
key.description: Key that defines how to uniquely identify the add-on.

requires.title: Requires
requires.description:
Requires defines any additional addons that this one depends on to operate
correctly.

sources.title: Sources
sources.description: Sources is a list of sources that are used to provide the data for the add-on.

extensions.title: Extensions
extensions.description: Extensions defines the list of extensions that are associated with an add-on.

tags.title: Tags
tags.description: Tags is slice of tag sets that define what can be assigned to each document schema.

scenarios.title: Scenarios
scenarios.description:
Scenarios are applied to documents after normalization and before
validation to ensure that form specific extensions have been added
to the document.

identities.title: Identities
identities.description:
Identities that are specific for the add-on and may be validated against or
used during conversion processes.

inboxes.title: Inboxes
inboxes.description:
Inboxes is a list of keys that are used to identify where copies of
documents can be sent.

corrections.title: Corrections
corrections.description:
Corrections is used to provide a map of correction definitions that
are supported by the add-on.

thresholds.title: Thresholds
thresholds.description: Thresholds define monetary limits that rules compare document amounts against.

tax.AddonDef.description: AddonDef is an interface that defines the methods that a tax add-on must implement.

key.title: Key
key.description: Key used to identify the threshold in rules.

currency.title: Currency
currency.description: Currency the threshold amounts are expressed in.

values.title: Values
values.description:
Values contains the current and historical amounts of the threshold,
ordered newest first.

tax.ThresholdDef.description: ThresholdDef defines a monetary limit that document amounts are compared against, such as the total above which an invoice must identify the customer.

since.title: Since
since.description: Date from which this value should be applied.

tax.ThresholdValueDef.description: ThresholdValueDef contains the threshold amount from a given date.
